diff --git a/src/click/secondary_incomplete_option.py b/src/click/secondary_incomplete_option.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..ec8adc6
--- /dev/null
+++ b/src/click/secondary_incomplete_option.py
@@ -0,0 +1,36 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from .core import Context
+from .core import Option
+from .core import Parameter
+from .shell_completion import _start_of_option
+
+
+def secondary_incomplete_option(
+    ctx: Context, args: list[str], param: Parameter
+) -> bool:
+    """Determine if the given parameter is an option that needs a value.
+    Like ``_is_incomplete_option``, but also matches the option's
+    secondary names.
+
+    :param args: List of complete args before the incomplete value.
+    :param param: Option object being checked.
+    """
+    if not isinstance(param, Option):
+        return False
+
+    if param.is_flag or param.count:
+        return False
+
+    last_option = None
+
+    for index, arg in enumerate(reversed(args)):
+        if index + 1 > param.nargs:
+            break
+
+        if _start_of_option(ctx, arg):
+            last_option = arg
+
+    return last_option is not None and (
+        last_option in param.opts or last_option in param.secondary_opts
+    )
diff --git a/tests/test_secondary_incomplete_option.py b/tests/test_secondary_incomplete_option.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..3120e69
--- /dev/null
+++ b/tests/test_secondary_incomplete_option.py
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+import click
+from click.secondary_incomplete_option import secondary_incomplete_option
+
+
+def _ctx(*params):
+    cli = click.Command("cli", params=list(params))
+    return cli.make_context("cli", [], resilient_parsing=True)
+
+
+def test_matches_primary_and_secondary():
+    opt = click.Option(["--name"])
+    opt.secondary_opts = ["--other-name"]
+    ctx = _ctx(opt)
+    assert secondary_incomplete_option(ctx, ["--name"], opt)
+    assert secondary_incomplete_option(ctx, ["--other-name"], opt)
+    assert not secondary_incomplete_option(ctx, ["--nope"], opt)
+
+
+def test_empty_args_and_non_option():
+    opt = click.Option(["-n"])
+    arg = click.Argument(["x"])
+    ctx = _ctx(opt, arg)
+    assert not secondary_incomplete_option(ctx, [], opt)
+    assert not secondary_incomplete_option(ctx, ["-n"], arg)
+    assert secondary_incomplete_option(ctx, ["-n"], opt)
+
+
+def test_flags_and_counts():
+    flag = click.Option(["--f/--no-f"])
+    count = click.Option(["-v"], count=True)
+    ctx = _ctx(flag, count)
+    assert not secondary_incomplete_option(ctx, ["--no-f"], flag)
+    assert not secondary_incomplete_option(ctx, ["-v"], count)
+
+
+def test_nargs():
+    opt = click.Option(["-p"], nargs=2)
+    ctx = _ctx(opt)
+    assert secondary_incomplete_option(ctx, ["-p", "a"], opt)
+    assert not secondary_incomplete_option(ctx, ["-p", "a", "b"], opt)
notes:
Added secondary_incomplete_option mirroring _is_incomplete_option (reusing _start_of_option) but matching the last option token against param.opts or param.secondary_opts; existing code untouched, with unit tests covering primary/secondary names, empty args, non-options, flags/counts, and nargs.
